# garage_bucket (Data Source)

Looks up a bucket by ID or global alias, with its usage and the keys that have access to it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_bucket" "app" {
  global_alias = "app-data"
}

output "app_usage_bytes" {
  value = data.garage_bucket.app.bytes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `global_alias` (String) Global alias to look up.
- `id` (String) Bucket ID.

### Read-Only

- `bytes` (Number) Total size of the objects, in bytes.
- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `global_aliases` (List of String) All global aliases of the bucket.
- `keys` (Attributes List) Keys with permissions on the bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))
- `local_aliases` (Attributes List) Local aliases of the bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--local_aliases))
- `max_objects` (Number) Object count quota, if any.
- `max_size` (Number) Size quota, in bytes, if any.
- `objects` (Number) Number of objects.
- `unfinished_multipart_uploads` (Number) Number of unfinished multipart uploads.
- `unfinished_uploads` (Number) Number of unfinished uploads.
- `website_enabled` (Boolean) Whether website hosting is enabled.

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `access_key_id` (String)
- `local_aliases` (List of String)
- `name` (String)
- `owner` (Boolean)
- `read` (Boolean)
- `write` (Boolean)


<a id="nestedatt--local_aliases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `local_aliases`

Read-Only:

- `alias` (String)
